en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground stands a dark stone obelisk‑like monument partly surrounded by bushes and shrubs. Beyond it lies a village with scattered houses, larger villas and buildings among trees, with rolling fields and wooded ridges in the background. The caption at the top reads "Bärenfels — Ost-Erzgebirge".
